U.S. Coast Guard - Station Oswego
navaid.description: Coast Guard Station Oswego is a multi-mission station. It performs Search and Rescue, Maritime Law Enforcement, and Homeland Security missions. The area of responsibility extends from Sodus Bay to Cape Vincent, NY and out to the international border.

navaid.name: Oswego Harbor West Pierhead Light
navaid.description: The interior originally contained a fourth order Fresnel lens which was replaced in 1995. The original lens is currently housed nearby at the H. Lee White Maritime Museum in Oswego.
